title: Realtime + UX Integration

features: Automatic reconnect with exponential backoff (max 5 attempts, 1s-30s delay)
Sequence number tracking for event ordering
realtime_architecture.fallback: SSE automatically used if WebSocket fails or as configured preference

ux_integration.loading_states: Per-component loading states via useUIStore (cameras, attendance, events, search, replay, provenance, enrollment, timetable)
ux_integration.error_states: Per-component error states via useUIStore with clearError function
ux_integration.empty_states: Implemented in PersonSearch, TimetableManagement, ParentTelegram, ExcelExport
ux_integration.reconnect_handling: Real-time connection status shown in top nav bar and SystemHealth page
ux_integration.offline_behavior: UI remains functional with cached data, shows 'Real-time Disconnected' status
graceful_degradation: Camera unavailable: Shows 'No Signal' overlay on CameraCard
Telegram unavailable: Shows 'Not Linked' status, queue stats show error
Backend temporarily unavailable: Polling continues, WebSocket reconnects automatically
No timetable exists: Empty state with 'Add Entry' CTA
No attendance exists: Shows 'No live events' message
No parent linked: Shows 'Not Linked' with 'Link' button

components_with_realtime: CommandCenter (dashboard) - live camera health, system status, event stream
SystemHealth - detailed camera metrics, GPU status, queue metrics, alerts
PersonSearch - could subscribe to attendance events for live updates
PersonDetail - could show real-time appearance updates

connection_status_ui.top_nav: Shows 'Real-time Connected'/'Real-time Disconnected' with status dot
connection_status_ui.system_health_page: Detailed connection status with sync/disconnect buttons

testing_scenarios: Backend restart: WebSocket reconnects automatically, syncs state
Network interruption: Exponential backoff reconnect, max 5 attempts
Multiple tabs: Each gets independent connection with unique connection_id
SSE fallback: Works when WebSocket unavailable (corporate firewalls)
